title: Value: After Hours S02 E34 Dan Loeb on Strategy, Buy Now Pay Later $QVCC, Cocker Spandrels
summary: We uncover the tactics and strategies for finding good investments, managing risk, dealing with bad luck, and maximizing success. He has extensive experience in investment management, business valuation, public company corporate governance, and corporate law.
